elaine: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — we need owner+due for remediation items before next game day. Key buckets: multi-region routing tests, snapshot retention audit, restore dry-run, and detection alerts. Please claim.

manu: I'll take routing tests. Will build a canary script with ramp + cache-warm steps. ETA 14 days.

zach: I'll audit snapshots and cross-region copy jobs and propose retention per region. ETA 10 days.

sophie: I'll run the staging restore dry-run and validate the runbook. Need IAM list from ops. Scheduling for next rehearsal window.

oncall: I'll analyze past incidents for detection latency and propose alert thresholds; expect ~7 days.

kevin: Ops: opening ticket to grant elevated-read for eu-prod snapshots; blocking Zach until approved.

incident-bot: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/dr/trackers/DR-3101234567 — update with owner + due.

elaine: When you claim, paste tracker ID + one-line acceptance criteria here (how we know it's done). Also call out blockers.

manu: DR-3101234567-ROUTING claimed by @manu, due 2026-04-27 — acceptance: scripted canary completes 3 runs with <2% errors and cache hit >80%.

zach: DR-3101234567-BACKUPS claimed by @zach, due 2026-04-23 — acceptance: cross-region copies verified for 14d, retention proposal posted. Blocker: eu-prod read role.

sophie: DR-3101234567-RESTORE claimed by @sophie, due 2026-04-15 — acceptance: full staging restore completes and verification scripts pass.

oncall: DR-3101234567-ALERTS claimed by @oncall, due 2026-04-20 — acceptance: alerts fire in test harness within 60s and trigger runbook.

elaine: Thanks. I'll collect these into the game-day runbook and run a 15-min sync one week before the dry-run. If blockers persist, escalate to execs.

kevin: Ticket #INC-78321 opened for eu-prod role; marking DR-3101234567-BACKUPS blocked until approved.

elaine: Closing thread — please update tracker as you make progress. :thumbsup:
